judge_edits.from: اور یہ ٹکٹ اسی گاؤں سے ملتا ہے
judge_edits.to: اور یہ ٹکٹ اسی گاؤں سے خریدا جاتا ہے
judge_edits.why: Blind item 1 (moderate): «ملتا ہے» reads colloquial and slightly odd for a ticket; the reader offered «خریدا جاتا ہے» / «میں ملتا ہے». «خریدا جاتا ہے» is the closer rendering of the Arabic «تُباع عبر «أرض الحضارات»» (the ticket is sold through the village), adds no fact (no place, no distance, no price), and keeps «اسی گاؤں» pointing back to the village already named with its gloss in the same sentence. The first sentence, the village name with its gloss and «نامی ثقافتی گاؤں» are untouched.

rulings: ur-legal-lead: APPROVED as proposed. The adverb «صریح» is the only word removed; «قبولیت» is feminine and «کی» already agrees (ar_after «قبولًا بهذه الشروط»). The blind reader (item 22) read it as clear and standard. ur-legal-mascot: APPROVED as proposed. «سفید گالوں والی بلبل» is accepted on the owner's wording («البلبل أبيض الخدين»); the reader read it without trouble and found the agreement acceptable (item 25). Only the species word changed. ur-qarah-fee: one judge edit (above). Everything else kept: «بڑوں کے لیے 50 سعودی ریال» exact, the village name in marks with its gloss «(تہذیبوں کی سرزمین)» and «نامی ثقافتی گاؤں» exactly as the published card writes them (P3b/P15, first mention in the field), «شامل ہیں» for the two masculine nouns جبل القارہ and ارض الحضارات, one «۔» between the two sentences, no final stop, no child fare. ur-hadarat-fee: APPROVED as proposed. The source is silent on where to buy on this card, so nothing is added (reader item 4: clear, consistent). The village name stands in marks bare, as this page's own title (N137) and four FAQ questions write it; the gloss and the «نامی ثقافتی گاؤں» generic belong to the body's first mention (the body of this page, line 27, already carries both). Option for the owner, not applied: if the table cell on /ur/plan-your-trip/ is read as an independent first mention (P15), the Qarah-card form with the generic is the alternative. ur-stores-bisht: APPROVED as proposed. Only the UNESCO clause changed; «بحیثیت مجموعی چوغہ» is kept: the reader (item 9) read it as 'the cloak as a whole', no fault; «عمومی طور پر / عموماً» would read as 'usually' and is worse. The clause drops the Hasawi attribution of the inscription and says intangible list and 2025 as N779 as narrowed by the owner. «یونیسکو کی غیر مادی ثقافتی ورثے کی فہرست» follows the tm pair «یونیسکو کی عالمی ورثے کی فہرست» and moves with it in the site-wide review UNESCO-LIST-PAIR (owner 2026-10-17: not changed page by page); the reader found the agreement fine. «غیر مادی ثقافتی ورثہ» has no attestation in tm; recorded as N865. ur-plan.tableEvent: «تقریب» stays by coordinator decision 7 (the singular is attested in the site's own ui: nav.events «تقریبات», evd.mapFrameTitle «تقریب کی جگہ کا نقشہ»); one word, no punctuation, no case. Reader item 11 (serious) is about the table, not the tag: the tag is understood as 'event'; the «—» fee cell and the date wording are outside the twelve positions and logged under source_defects. ur-qubba-hours: APPROVED as proposed. The bracket and the space before it are removed; «قصر ابراہیم» is the termbase entry; «کھلی رہتی ہے» feminine for the mosque. The reader's note that no hours are given (item 13) is the owner's decision (SD-P1) and no hours are added (decision 2). ur-uqair-fee: APPROVED as proposed. «اندر داخلہ نہیں» renders «لا دخول إلى الداخل» / 'No entry inside', in the form of the old «داخلہ مفت» (no copula, no final stop); the reader (item 15) understood 'no entry inside, viewable from outside'. No cost statement beyond the source (decision 2); the reader's doubt whether the outside view costs anything is a source matter, logged. «اندر داخلہ ممنوع» is rejected: it adds a prohibition the source does not carry. Titles (decision 4): ur-sawsan-title «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات» = N156 option C as recorded word for word in b10 (stage-1 translator and stage-4 candidates: C «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات»); ur-taraf-title «الطرف نامی قصبے کا چڑیا گھر» = N157 option B as recorded (stage-4 candidates and N157/«الطرف کا چڑیا گھر» note: B «الطرف نامی قصبے کا چڑیا گھر»); the reader (item 17) called it a good title, 'the zoo of the town named Al-Taraf'. No recorded ruling words either differently, so both are adopted as proposed. The reader's doubt on «پرندوں کے باغات» (aviary, park, or gardens with birds; item 16) is the generic of N156 as ruled («پرندوں کے باغات» for «حدائق … للطيور»); no source says what Al-Sawsan is (logged for the owner since b10 round 1); no change. ur-tarafa-title: «ہجر نامی شہر» at the one bare «ہجر» (N806 first-mention rule); the reader (item 18) says «نامی» is what saved him from reading 'separation'. ur-tarafa-desc: the first mention (the opening question) takes «ہجر نامی شہر»; the second «ہجر اور بحرین کا مطلب» stays bare (N806 (3): the name is already introduced as a city in the same unit and stands beside بحرین and یاقوت الحموی کے ہاں); the reader (items 18, 20) raised no doubt on it, so it is not extended. Every current is copied byte-exact from the pack; every proposed is one line, U+0020 only, no NBSP, no ZWNJ, no Arabic letterforms, no kasra, Latin digits, no final «۔» on any card value or title; P13 hours form untouched (the Qubba bracket is removed, no time is written), P20 untouched.

new_rulings.title: «نامی» is allowed in a title for a name that reads as a common word (owner, 2026-10-23): the three titles
new_rulings.binds: sawsan-gardens::title_ur; taraf-zoo::title_ur; tarafa-ibn-al-abd-ur::title; any later /ur/ title whose name is read as a common word by a reader (not every name: only one a blind reader read as a common word)
new_rulings.ruling: OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-23: a title may carry «نامی» for a name that reads as a common word (Al-Sawsan read as the lily, Al-Taraf as 'side', Hajar as 'separation'). The three titles as published after this batch: «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات» (N156 C, recorded word for word in b10); «الطرف نامی قصبے کا چڑیا گھر» (N157 B, recorded word for word in b10); and the Tarafa article's title with «ہجر نامی شہر» at the one place where «ہجر» stood bare (N806's first-mention rule), the description carrying the same form at its first mention only. The termbase KEY of each name is unchanged (the keys «السوسن کے پرندوں کے باغات», «الطرف کا چڑیا گھر» and «ہجر» stand verbatim); the title forms are recorded as notes on those entries. Evidence: blind reader on the built pages (06-blind, items 16-18): «نامی» introduces the name well, makes the zoo's town a town, and is what kept «ہجر» from being read as 'separation'. Cost: the Sawsan title still does not say what the place is (the generic of N156, an owner question since b10).
new_rulings.guard: A title with «نامی» is allowed only for a name a reader read as a common word, as recorded here and in N156/N157/N806; the name before «نامی» is byte-identical to its termbase key; no bracket (the three exceptions of P3c-labels stand) and no gloss in the title; a generic after «نامی» is allowed (that is not 'next to the name'); no «نامی» in a label, a kicker or a breadcrumb unless a later ruling says so.

new_rulings.binds: jabal-al-qarah::value_ur (fees); ardh-alhadarat::value_ur (fees); the cells of the same two rows in the hours-and-fees table; any later /ur/ text repeating the claim
new_rulings.ruling: Qarah card: «بڑوں کے لیے 50 سعودی ریال۔ ایک ٹکٹ میں جبل القارہ اور “ارض الحضارات” (تہذیبوں کی سرزمین) نامی ثقافتی گاؤں شامل ہیں، اور یہ ٹکٹ اسی گاؤں سے خریدا جاتا ہے» (ar «تُباع عبر «أرض الحضارات»»: the sale clause says the ticket is bought from the village, «خریدا جاتا ہے» after the reader found «ملتا ہے» colloquial). Hadarat card: «بڑوں کے لیے 50 سعودی ریال۔ ایک ٹکٹ میں “ارض الحضارات” اور جبل القارہ شامل ہیں» (source order kept; the name in marks bare, as this page's title and FAQ questions write it; the source is silent on the purchase place there, so none is written). No child fare, no new hours, no distance. One «۔» between the sentences, none at the end of a card value.
new_rulings.guard: Both values end without «۔»; the Qarah value contains «50 سعودی ریال» once and «تہذیبوں کی سرزمین» once; neither value contains «بچوں» or any other fare.

The hours line «باہر سے دیکھا جا سکتا ہے» stays.
new_rulings.guard: The fee value of uqair-castle is exactly «اندر داخلہ نہیں»; the words «مفت» and «ممنوع» count 0 in it.

new_rulings.ruling: «یونیسکو کی غیر مادی ثقافتی ورثے کی فہرست» for 'UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list', following the tm pair «یونیسکو کی عالمی ورثے کی فہرست»; «غیر مادی ثقافتی ورثہ» has no tm attestation and enters as a generic from this batch (the reader found the clause clear and the agreement fine). amendments.append: AMENDED BY owner-rulings-1023 (owner decision 2026-10-23, N858), in the guard only: «نامی» is no longer barred in a TITLE for a name that reads as a common word. The three titles that carry it: «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات» (N156 C), «الطرف نامی قصبے کا چڑیا گھر» (N157 B), and the Tarafa article's title with «ہجر نامی شہر» (N806). The name before «نامی» is byte-identical to its termbase key, and the termbase keys are unchanged. Unchanged: the bracket rule (the three exceptions of N103, N294 and N521) and 'no Urdu generic next to a name that already carries its Arabic generic' (a generic after «نامی» is not next to the name); labels, kickers and questions still carry the name bare.

ROUND OWNER (owner-rulings-1023, 2026-10-23): ANSWERED by the owner: «نامی» is allowed in a title for a name that reads as a common word (N858). C is ADOPTED: the title is «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات» (the possessive «کے» of A is replaced; «باغات» masculine plural unchanged). The termbase key «السوسن کے پرندوں کے باغات» stays as the key; the published title is recorded as a note on it. The reader of the built page (06-blind item 16) understood it as a place named Al-Sawsan; his doubt whether it is an aviary or gardens with birds is the generic of this ruling and stays. The owner question on 'what Al-Sawsan is' remains open. Guard now: the title is «السوسن نامی پرندوں کے باغات»; masculine plural by «باغات».

ROUND OWNER (owner-rulings-1023, 2026-10-23): ANSWERED by the owner (N858): B is ADOPTED: the title is «الطرف نامی قصبے کا چڑیا گھر» (the oblique «قصبے» before «کا», the pattern of N73 (2); «چڑیا گھر» masculine). The termbase key «الطرف کا چڑیا گھر» stays as the key and the name of the zoo in the body, which this batch does not touch. The reader of the built page (06-blind item 17) called it a good title. Guard now: «نامی» stands with the town at every mention, including the title; the key of the zoo in the termbase is unchanged.

ROUND OWNER (owner-rulings-1023, 2026-10-23): the owner NARROWED the claim at source (SD-S12): what UNESCO inscribed is the bisht in general, on the Intangible Cultural Heritage list, in 2025; no Hasawi attribution.
